{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure we have the latest
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, removing currency symbols and commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any problematic values after conversion
revenue_issues = sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Check the unique values in 'status' column
unique_status = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Print results
revenue_issues, unique_status"}
